tagline: Slime chunk maps for Minecraft Java and Bedrock
description: MC Seed Kit provides free browser-based tools for Minecraft worlds. Its Slime Chunk Finder maps slime chunks near a player's position for Java and Bedrock Edition, lists the nearest chunks with their block boundaries and distances, and lets players share a map link. Java Edition uses the world seed; Bedrock Edition only needs X and Z coordinates. Calculations run locally in the browser, with no installation or account required. Players can also check whether a base lies in a slime chunk and save a world locally on their device. MC Seed Kit is an independent fan project and is not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.
features: Slime chunk maps for Minecraft Java and Bedrock
Nearest slime chunks with block boundaries and distances
Shareable map links with seed and coordinates
Client-side calculations; no installation or account required
Save a world locally in your browser
